integrity.evidence: Analytical proof plus exact-rational standalone checker with 117 finite instances; experiments do not prove arbitrary graph claims.

scientific_limitations: Only asymptotically stable equilibria are classified; basins, unstable states, and transients are not classified.

The central slope restriction 0<epsilon<b/(b+d_max) is necessary for the stated proof and class.
